BitField.description: Write Leveling Step\nSpecifies the number of delay step-size increments during each step of write leveling. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: WLSTEP

BitField.description: Write System Latency Optimization\nControls the insertion of a pipeline stage on the AC signals from the DFI interface to the PHY to cater for a negative write system latency (WSL) value (only -1 possible).\n
BitField.name: WSLOPT

BitField.description: AC PHY High-Speed Reset\nA Write of '0' to this bit resets the AC macro without resetting the PUB RTL logic. This bit is not self-clearing and a '1' must be written to de-assert the reset.
BitField.name: ACHRST

BitField.description: Write Leveling Select Type\nSelects the encoding type for the write leveling select signal depending on the desired setup/hold margins for the internal pipelines. Refer to the DDR PHY Databook for details of how the select type is used. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: WLSELT

BitField.description: I/O DDR Mode for D3F I/O Only\nSelects the DDR mode for the I/Os. These bits connect to bits [2:1] of the IOM pin of the SSTL I/O. For more information, refer to the SSTL I/O chapter in the DWC DDR PHY Databook.
BitField.name: IODDRM

BitField.description: Master Delay Line Enable\nEnables, if set, the AC master delay line calibration to perform subsequent period measurements following the initial period measurements that are performed after reset or on when calibration is manually triggered. These additional measurements are accumulated and filtered as long as this bit remains high.
BitField.name: MDLEN

BitField.description: Low-Pass Filter Enable\nEnables, if set, the low pass filtering of MDL period measurements.
BitField.name: LPFEN

BitField.description: Low-Pass Filter Depth\nSpecifies the number of measurements over which MDL period measurements are filtered. This determines the time constant of the low pass filter. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: LPFDEPTH

BitField.description: Filter Depth\nSpecifies the number of measurements over which all AC and DATX8 initial period measurements, that happen after reset or when calibration is manually triggered, are averaged. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: FDEPTH

BitField.description: Delay Line VT Drift Limit\nSpecifies the minimum change in the delay line VT drift in one direction which should result in the assertion of the delay line VT drift status signal (vt_drift). The limit is specified in terms of delay select values. A value of 0 disables the assertion of delay line VT drift status signal.
BitField.name: DLDLMT

BitField.description:
Impedance Clock Divider Select
Selects the divide ratio for the clock used by the impedance control logic relative to the clock used by the memory controller and SDRAM.
Valid values are:
BitField.name: ZCKSEL

BitField.description: DX PHY High-Speed Reset\na Write of '0' to this bit resets the DX macro without resetting the PUB RTL logic. This bit is not self-clearing and a '1' must be written to de-assert the reset.
BitField.name: DXHRST

BitField.description: VT Calculation Inhibit\nInhibits calculation of the next VT compensated delay line values. A value of 1 will inhibit the VT calculation. This bit should be set to 1 during writes to the delay line registers.
BitField.name: INHVT

BitField.description: I/O Loop-Back Select\nSelects where inside the I/O the loop-back of signals happens. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: IOLB

BitField.description: Loopback DQS Shift\nSelects how the read DQS is shifted during loopback to ensure that the read DQS is centered into the read data eye. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: LBDQSS

BitField.description: Loopback DQS Gating\nSelects the DQS gating mode that should be used when the PHY is in loopback mode, including BIST loopback mode. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: LBGDQS

BitField.description: Loopback Mode\nIndicates, if set, that the PHY/PUB is in loopback mode.
BitField.name: LBMODE

BitField.description: Initialization Done\nIndicates, if set, that the DDR system initialization has completed. This bit is set after all the selected initialization routines in PIR register have completed.
BitField.name: IDONE

BitField.description: PLL Lock Done\nIndicates, if set, that PLL locking has completed.
BitField.name: PLDONE

BitField.description: Digital Delay Line Calibration Done\nIndicates, if set, that DDL calibration has completed.
BitField.name: DCDONE

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Done: Indicates, if set, that impedance calibration has completed.
BitField.name: ZCDONE

BitField.description: DRAM Initialization Done\nIndicates, if set, that DRAM initialization has completed.
BitField.name: DIDONE

BitField.description: Write Leveling Done\nIndicates, if set, that write leveling has completed.
BitField.name: WLDONE

BitField.description: Read DQS Gate Training Done\nIndicates, if set, that DQS gate training has completed.
BitField.name: QSGDONE

BitField.description: Write Leveling Adjustment Done\nIndicates, if set, that write leveling adjustment has completed.
BitField.name: WLADONE

BitField.description: Read Data Bit Deskew Done\nIndicates, if set, that read bit deskew has completed.
BitField.name: RDDONE

BitField.description: Write Data Bit Deskew Done\nIndicates, if set, that write bit deskew has completed.
BitField.name: WDDONE

BitField.description: Read Data Eye Training Done\nIndicates, if set, that read eye training has completed.
BitField.name: REDONE

BitField.description: Write Data Eye Training Done\nIndicates, if set, that write eye training has completed.
BitField.name: WEDONE

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in impedance calibration.
BitField.name: ZCERR

BitField.description: Write Leveling Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in write leveling.
BitField.name: WLERR

BitField.description: Read DQS Gate Training Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in DQS gate training.
BitField.name: QSGERR

BitField.description: Write Data Leveling Adjustment Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in write leveling adjustment.
BitField.name: WLAERR

BitField.description: Read Data Bit Deskew Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in read bit deskew.
BitField.name: RDERR

BitField.description: Write Data Bit Deskew Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in write bit deskew.
BitField.name: WDERR

BitField.description: Read Data Eye Training Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in read eye training.
BitField.name: REERR

BitField.description: Write Eye Training Error\nIndicates, if set, that there is an error in write eye training.
BitField.name: WEERR

BitField.description: PLL Lock Done per Channel\nIndicates PLL locking has completed for each underlying channel. Bit 28 represents channel 0 while bit 29 represents channel 1.
BitField.name: PLDONE_CHN

BitField.description: AC PLL Lock\nIndicates, if set, that AC PLL has locked. This is a direct status of the AC PLL lock pin.
BitField.name: APLOCK

BitField.description: Delay Line Test Done\nIndicates, if set, that the PHY control block has finished doing period measurement of the AC delay line digital test output.
BitField.name: DLTDONE

BitField.description: Delay Line Test Code\nReturns the code measured by the PHY control block that corresponds to the period of the AC delay line digital test output.
BitField.name: DLTCODE

BitField.description: VT Stop\nIndicates, if set, that the VT calculation logic has stopped computing the next values for the VT compensated delay line values. After assertion of the PGCR.INHVT, the VTSTOP bit should be read to ensure all VT compensation logic has stopped computations before writing to the delay line registers.
BitField.name: VTSTOP

BitField.description: RDIMM Parity Error\nIndicates, if set, that there was a parity error (i.e. err_out_n was sampled low) during one of the transactions to the RDIMM buffer chip. This bit remains asserted until cleared by the PIR.CLRSR.
BitField.name: PARERR

BitField.description: Digital Test Control\nSelects various PLL digital test signals and other test mode signals to be brought out via bit [1] of the PLL digital test output (pll_dto[1]). Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: DTC

BitField.description: Analog Test Control\nSelects various PLL analog test signals to be brought out via PLL analog test output pin (pll_ato). Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: ATC

BitField.description: Analog Test Enable\nSelects the analog test signal that is driven on the analog test output pin. Otherwise the analog test output is tri-stated. This allows analog test output pins from multiple PLLs to be connected together. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: ATOEN

BitField.description: Gear Shift\nEnables, if set, rapid locking mode.
BitField.name: GSHIFT

BitField.description: Charge Pump Integrating Current Control
BitField.name: CPIC

BitField.description: Charge Pump Proportional Current Control
BitField.name: CPPC

BitField.description: PLL Quadrature Phase Mode\nEnables, if set, the quadrature phase clock outputs. This mode is not used in this version of the PHY.
BitField.name: QPMODE

BitField.description: PLL Frequency Select\n
BitField.name: FRQSEL

BitField.description: PLL Power Down\nPuts the PLLs in Power-down mode by driving the PLL power down pin. This bit is not self-clearing and a '0' must be written to de-assert the power-down.
BitField.name: PLLPD

BitField.description: PLL Rest\nResets the PLLs by driving the PLL reset pin. This bit is not self-clearing and a '0' must be written to de-assert the reset.
BitField.name: PLLRST

BitField.description: PLL Bypass\nBypasses the PLL, if set, to 1.
BitField.name: BYP

BitField.description: PHY Reset Time\nNumber of configuration or APB clock cycles that the PHY reset must remain asserted after PHY calibration is done before the reset to the PHY is de-asserted. This is used to extend the reset to the PHY so that the reset is asserted for some clock cycles after the clocks are stable. Valid values are from 1 to 63 (the value must be non-zero).
BitField.name: tPHYRST

BitField.description: PLL Gear Shift Time\nNumber of configuration or APB clock cycles from when the PLL reset pin is de-asserted to when the PLL gear shift pin is de-asserted. This must correspond to a value that is equal to or more than 4us. Default value corresponds to 4us.
BitField.name: tPLLGS

BitField.description: PLL Power-Down Time\nNumber of configuration or APB clock cycles that the PLL must remain in power-down mode, i.e. number of clock cycles from when PLL power-down pin is asserted to when PLL power-down pin is de-asserted. This must correspond to a value that is equal to or more than 1us. Default value corresponds to 1us.
BitField.name: tPLLPD

BitField.description: PLL Reset Time\nNumber of configuration or APB clock cycles that the PLL must remain in reset mode, i.e. number of clock cycles from when PLL power-down pin is de-asserted and PLL reset pin is asserted to when PLL reset pin is de-asserted. The setting must correspond to a value that is equal to, or greater than 3us.
BitField.name: tPLLRST

BitField.description: PLL Lock Time\nNumber of configuration or APB clock cycles for the PLL to stabilize and lock, i.e. number of clock cycles from when the PLL reset pin is de-asserted to when the PLL has lock and is ready for use. This must correspond to a value that is equal to or more than 100us. Default value corresponds to 100us.
BitField.name: tPLLLOCK

BitField.description: Calibration On Time\nNumber of clock cycles that the calibration clock is enabled (cal_clk_en asserted).
BitField.name: tCALON

BitField.description: Calibration Setup Time\nNumber of controller clock cycles from when calibration is enabled (cal_en asserted) to when the calibration clock is asserted again (cal_clk_en asserted).
BitField.name: tCALS

BitField.description: Calibration Hold Time\nNumber of controller clock cycles from when the clock was disabled (cal_clk_en deasserted) to when calibration is enable (cal_en asserted).
BitField.name: tCALH

BitField.description: Write Leveling Delay Settling Time\nNumber of controller clock cycles from when a new value of the write leveling delay is applied to the LCDL to when to DQS high is driven high. This allows the delay to settle.
BitField.name: tWLDLYS

BitField.description: DRAM Initialization Time 0\nDRAM initialization time in DRAM clock cycles corresponding to the following:\nDuring Verilog simulations, it is recommended that this value is changed to a much smaller value in order to avoid long simulation times. However, this may cause a memory model error, due to a violation of the CKE setup sequence. This violation is expected if this value is not programmed to the required SDRAM CKE low time, but memory models should be able to tolerate this violation without malfunction of the model.
BitField.name: tDINIT0

BitField.description: DRAM Initialization Time 1\nDRAM initialization time in DRAM clock cycles corresponding to the following:\nDefault value corresponds to DDR3 tRFC of 360ns at 1066 MHz.
BitField.name: tDINIT1

BitField.description: DRAM Initialization Time 2\nDRAM initialization time in DRAM clock cycles corresponding to the following:\n
BitField.name: tDINIT2

BitField.description: DRAM Initialization Time 3\nDRAM initialization time in DRAM clock cycles corresponding to the following:\n
BitField.name: tDINIT3

BitField.description: Initial Period\nInitial period measured by the master delay line calibration for VT drift compensation. This value is used as the denominator when calculating the ratios of updates during VT compensation.
BitField.name: IPRD

BitField.description: Target Period\nTarget period measured by the master delay line calibration for VT drift compensation. This is the current measured value of the period and is continuously updated if the MDL is enabled to do so.
BitField.name: TPRD

BitField.description: MDL Delay\nDelay select for the LCDL for the Master Delay Line.
BitField.name: MDLD

BitField.description: CK0 Bit Delay\nDelay select for the BDL on CK0.
BitField.name: CK0BD

BitField.description: CK1 Bit Delay\nDelay select for the BDL on CK1.
BitField.name: CK1BD

BitField.description: CK2 Bit Delay\nDelay select for the BDL on CK2.
BitField.name: CK2BD

BitField.description: Address/Command Bit Delay\nDelay select for the BDLs on address and command signals.
BitField.name: ACBD

BitField.description: Address/Command I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for all address and command pins. This bit connects to bit [0] of the IOM pin on the D3F I/Os, and for other I/O libraries, it connects to the IOM pin of the I/O.
BitField.name: ACIOM

BitField.description: Address/Command Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for all address and command pins.
BitField.name: ACOE

BitField.description: Address/Command On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for RAS#, CAS#, WE#, BA[2:0], and A[15:0] pins.
BitField.name: ACODT

BitField.description: AC Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for RAS#, CAS#, WE#, BA[2:0], and A[15:0] pins.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: ACPDD

BitField.description: AC Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for RAS#, CAS#, WE#, BA[2:0], and A[15:0] pins.
BitField.name: ACPDR

BitField.description: CK On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for CK[0], CK[1], and CK[2] pins, respectively.
BitField.name: CKODT

BitField.description: CK Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for CK[0], CK[1], and CK[2] pins, respectively.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: CKPDD

BitField.description: CK Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for CK[0], CK[1], and CK[2] pins, respectively.
BitField.name: CKPDR

BitField.description: Rank On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for CKE[3:0], ODT[3:0], and CS#[3:0] pins. RANKODT[0] controls the on-die termination for CKE[0], ODT[0], and CS#[0], RANKODT[1] controls the on-die termination for CKE[1], ODT[1], and CS#[1], and so on.
BitField.name: RANKODT

BitField.description: CS# Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for CS#[3:0] pins. CSPDD[0] controls the power down for CS#[0], CSPDD[1] controls the power down for CS#[1], and so on. CKE and ODT driver power down is controlled by DSGCR register.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: CSPDD

BitField.description: Rank Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O CKE[3:0], ODT[3:0], and CS#[3:0] pins. RANKPDR[0] controls the power down for CKE[0], ODT[0], and CS#[0], RANKPDR[1] controls the power down for CKE[1], ODT[1], and CS#[1], and so on.
BitField.name: RANKPDR

BitField.description: SDRAM Reset On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for SDRAM RST# pin.
BitField.name: RSTODT

BitField.description: SDRAM Reset Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for SDRAM RST# pin.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: RSTPDD

BitField.description: SDRAM Reset Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for SDRAM RST# pin.
BitField.name: RSTPDR

BitField.description: SDRAM Reset I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for SDRAM Reset.
BitField.name: RSTIOM

BitField.description: Address/Command Slew Rate for D3F I/O Only\nSelects slew rate of the I/O for all address and command pins.
BitField.name: ACSR

BitField.description: Data On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of all DATX8 macros. This bit is ORed with the ODT configuration bit of the individual DATX8 ("DATX8 General Configuration Register (DXnGCR)")
BitField.name: DXODT

BitField.description: Data I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of all DATX8 macros. This bit is ORed with the IOM configuration bit of the individual DATX8.
BitField.name: DXIOM

BitField.description: Master Delay Line Enable\nEnables, if set, all DATX8 master delay line calibration to perform subsequent period measurements following the initial period measurements that are performed after reset or on when calibration is manually triggered. These additional measurements are accumulated and filtered as long as this bit remains high. This bit is ANDed with the MDLEN bit in the individual DATX8.
BitField.name: MDLEN

BitField.description: Data Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of all DATX8 macros. This bit is ORed with the PDD configuration bit of the individual DATX8.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: DXPDD

BitField.description: Data Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of all DATX8 macros. This bit is ORed with the PDR configuration bit of the individual DATX8.
BitField.name: DXPDR

BitField.description:
DQS Resistor
Selects the on-die pull-down/pull-up resistor for DQS pins. DQSRES[3] selects pull-down (when set to 0) or pull-up (when set to 1). DQSRES[2:0] selects the resistor value.
Refer PHY databook for pull-down/pull-up resistor values (RA_SEL/RB_SEL) for
DQS/DQS_b.
BitField.name: DQSRES

BitField.description:
DQS# Resistor
Selects the on-die pull-up/pull-down resistor for DQS# pins. Same encoding as DQSRES.
Refer PHY databook for pull-down/pull-up resistor values (RA_SEL/RB_SEL) for
DQS/DQS_b.
BitField.name: DQSNRES

BitField.description: Data Slew Rate for D3F I/O Only\nSelects slew rate of the I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of all DATX8 macros.
BitField.name: DXSR

BitField.description: Most Significant Byte Unused DQs\nSpecifies the number of DQ bits that are not used in the most significant byte. The used (valid) bits for this byte are [8-MSBDQ-1:0]. To disable the whole byte, use the DXnGCR.DXEN register.
BitField.name: MSBUDQ

BitField.description: Unused DQ On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for unused DQ pins.
BitField.name: UDQODT

BitField.description: Unused DQ Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for unused DQ pins.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: UDQPDD

BitField.description: Unused DQ Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for unused DQ pins.
BitField.name: UDQPDR

BitField.description: Unused DQ I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for unused DQ pins.
BitField.name: UDQIOM

BitField.description: Dynamic Data Power Down Driver\nDynamically powers down, when set, the output driver on I/O for the DQ pins of the active DATX8 macros. Applies only when DXPDD and DXnGCR.DXPDD are not set to 1. Driver is powered-up on a DFI WRITE command and powered-down (twrlat + WL/2 + n) HDR cycles after the last DFI WRITE command. Note that n is defined by the register bit field DXCCR[27:24] (DDPDDCDO).\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: DYNDXPDD

BitField.description: Data Power Down Receiver\nDynamically powers down, when set, the input receiver on I/O for the DQ pins of the active DATX8 macros. Applies only when DXPDR and DXnGCR.DXPDR are not set to 1. Receiver is powered-up on a DFI READ command and powered-down (trddata_en + fixed_read_latency + n) HDR cycles after the last DFI READ command. Note that n is defined by the register bit field DXCCR[31:28] (DDPDRCDO).
BitField.name: DYNDXPDR

BitField.description: Dynamic Data Power Down Driver Count Down Offset\nOffset applied in calculating window of time where driver is powered up
BitField.name: DDPDDCDO

BitField.description: Dynamic Data Power Down Receiver Count Down Offset\nOffset applied in calculating window of time where receiver is powered up
BitField.name: DDPDRCDO

BitField.description: PHY Update Request Enable\nSpecifies if set, that the PHY should issue PHY- initiated update request when there is DDL VT drift.
BitField.name: PUREN

BitField.description: Byte Disable Enable\nSpecifies, if set, that the PHY should respond to DFI byte disable request. Otherwise the byte disable from the DFI is ignored in which case bytes can only be disabled using the DXnGCR register.
BitField.name: BDISEN

BitField.description:
Impedance Update Enable
Specifies, if set, that in addition to DDL VT update, the PHY could also perform impedance calibration (update).
Refer to the "Impedance Control Register 0-1 (ZQnCR0-1)" bit fields DFICU0, DFICU1 and DFICCU bits to control if an impedance calibration is performed (update) with a DFI controller update request.
Refer to the "Impedance Control Register 0-1 (ZQnCR0-1)" bit fields DFIPU0 and DFIPU1 bits to control if an impedance calibration is performed (update) with a DFI PHY update request.
BitField.name: ZUEN

BitField.description: Low Power I/O Power Down\nSpecifies, if set, that the PHY should respond to the DFI low power opportunity request and power down the I/Os of the byte.
BitField.name: LPIOPD

BitField.description: Low Power PLL Power Down\nSpecifies, if set, that the PHY should respond to the DFI low power opportunity request and power down the PLL of the byte if the wakeup time request satisfies the PLL lock time.
BitField.name: LPPLLPD

BitField.description: Controller Update Acknowledge Enable\nSpecifies, if set, that the PHY should issue controller update acknowledge when the DFI controller update request is asserted. By default, the PHY does not acknowledge controller initiated update requests but simply does an update whenever there is a controller update request. This speeds up the update.
BitField.name: CUAEN

BitField.description: DQS Gate Extension\nSpecifies, if set, that the DQS gating must be extended by two DRAM clock cycles and then re-centered, i.e. one clock cycle extension on either side.
BitField.name: DQSGX

BitField.description: Bypass Rise-to-Rise Mode\nIndicates, if set, that the PHY bypass mode is configured to run in rise-to-rise mode. Otherwise if not set the PHY bypass mode is running in rise-to-fall mode.
BitField.name: BRRMODE

BitField.description: PHY Update Acknowledge Delay\nSpecifies the number of clock cycles that the indication for the completion of PHY update from the PHY to the controller should be delayed. This essentially delays, by this many clock cycles, the de-assertion of dfi_ctrlup_ack and dfi_phyupd_req signals relative to the time when the delay lines or I/Os are updated.
BitField.name: PUAD

BitField.description: DTO On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for DTO pins.
BitField.name: DTOODT

BitField.description: DTO Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for DTO pins.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: DTOPDD

BitField.description: DTO Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for DTO pins.
BitField.name: DTOPDR

BitField.description: DTO I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for DTO pins.
BitField.name: DTOIOM

BitField.description: DTO Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for DTO pins.
BitField.name: DTOOE

BitField.description: ATO Analog Test Enable\nEnables, if set, the analog test output (ATO) I/O.
BitField.name: ATOAE

BitField.description: Rise-to-Rise Mode\nIndicates, if set, that the PHY mission mode is configured to run in rise-to-rise mode. Otherwise if not set the PHY mission mode is running in rise-to- fall mode.
BitField.name: RRMODE

BitField.description: Single Data Rate Mode\nIndicates, if set, that the external controller is configured to run in single data rate (SDR) mode. Otherwise if not set the controller is running in half data rate (HDR) mode. This bit not supported in the current version of the PUB.
BitField.name: SDRMODE

BitField.description: CKE Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for CKE[3:0] pins. CKEPDD[0] controls the power down for CKE[0], CKEPDD[1] controls the power down for CKE[1], and so on.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: CKEPDD

BitField.description: ODT Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for ODT[3:0] pins. ODTPDD[0] controls the power down for ODT[0], ODTPDD[1] controls the power down for ODT[1], and so on.\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: ODTPDD

BitField.description: SDRAM CK Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for SDRAM CK/CK# pins.
BitField.name: CKOE

BitField.description: SDRAM ODT Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for SDRAM ODT pins.
BitField.name: ODTOE

BitField.description: SDRAM Reset Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for SDRAM RST# pin.
BitField.name: RSTOE

BitField.description: SDRAM CKE Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for SDRAM CKE pins.
BitField.name: CKEOE

BitField.description: DDR Mode\nSDRAM DDR mode. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: DDRMD

BitField.description: DDR 8-Bank\nNote that a setting of 1 for DRAMs that have fewer than 8 banks results in correct functionality, but less tight DRAM command spacing for the parameters.
BitField.name: DDR8BNK

BitField.description: Primary DQ for DDR3 Only\nSpecifies the DQ pin in a byte that is designated as a primary pin for Multi-Purpose Register (MPR) reads. Valid values are 0 to 7 for DQ[0] to DQ[7], respectively.
BitField.name: PDQ

BitField.description: Multi-Purpose Register DQ for DDR3 Only\nSpecifies the value that is driven on non-primary DQ pins during MPR reads. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: MPRDQ

BitField.description:
Byte Mask
Mask applied to all beats of read data on all byte lanes during read DQS gate training. This allows training to be conducted based on selected bit(s) from the byte lanes.
Valid values for each bit are:
Note that this mask applies in DDR3 MPR operation mode as well and must be in keeping with the PDQ field setting.
BitField.name: BYTEMASK

BitField.description: No Simultaneous Rank Access\nSpecifies, if set, that simultaneous rank access on the same clock cycle is not allowed. This means that multiple chip select signals should not be asserted at the same time. This may be required on some DIMM systems.
BitField.name: NOSRA

BitField.description: DDR 2T Timing\nIndicates, if set, that 2T timing should be used by PUB internally generated SDRAM transactions.
BitField.name: DDR2T

BitField.description: Un-buffered DIMM Address Mirroring\nIndicates, if set, that there is address mirroring on the second rank of an un-buffered DIMM (the rank connected to CS#[1]). In this case, the PUB re-scrambles the bank and address when sending mode register commands to the second rank. This only applies to PUB internal SDRAM transactions. Transactions generated by the controller must make its own adjustments when using an un-buffered DIMM. DCR[NOSRA] must be set if address mirroring is enabled.
BitField.name: UDIMM

BitField.description: Internal read to precharge command delay\nValid values are 2 to 15.
BitField.name: tRTP

BitField.description: Internal write to read command delay\nValid values are 1 to 15.
BitField.name: tWTR

BitField.description: Precharge command period\nThe minimum time between a precharge command and any other command. Note that the Controller automatically derives tRPA for 8- bank DDR2 devices by adding 1 to tRP. Valid values are 2 to 15.
BitField.name: tRP

BitField.description: Activate to read or write delay\nMinimum time from when an activate command is issued to when a read or write to the activated row can be issued. Valid values are 2 to 15.
BitField.name: tRCD

BitField.description: Activate to precharge command delay\nValid values are 2 to 63.
BitField.name: tRAS

BitField.description: Activate to activate command delay for the different banks\nValid values are 1 to 15.
BitField.name: tRRD

BitField.description: Activate to activate command delay for the same bank\nValid values are 2 to 63.
BitField.name: tRC

BitField.description: Load mode cycle time\nThe minimum time between a load mode register command and any other command. For DDR3 this is the minimum time between two load mode register commands. Valid values for DDR2 are 2 to 3. For DDR3, the value used for tMRD is 4 plus the value programmed in these bits, i.e. tMRD value for DDR3 ranges from 4 to 7.
BitField.name: tMRD

BitField.description: Load mode update delay for DDR3 only\nThe minimum time between a load mode register command and a non-load mode register command. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: tMOD

BitField.description: 4-bank activate period \nNo more than 4-bank activate commands may be issued in a given tFAW period. Only applies to 8-bank devices. Valid values are 2 to 63.
BitField.name: tFAW

BitField.description: Refresh-to-Refresh\nIndicates the minimum time between two refresh commands or between a refresh and an active command. This is derived from the minimum refresh interval from the Datasheet, tRFC(min), divided by the clock cycle time. The default number of clock cycles is for the largest JEDEC tRFC(min parameter value supported.
BitField.name: tRFC

BitField.description: Minimum delay from when write leveling mode is programmed to the first\nDQS/DQS# rising edge.
BitField.name: tWLMRD

BitField.description: Write leveling output delay\nNumber of clock cycles from when write leveling DQS is driven high by the control block to when the results from the SDRAM on DQ is sampled by the control block. This must include the SDRAM tWLO timing parameter plus the round trip delay from control block to SDRAM back to control block.
BitField.name: tWLO

BitField.description: ODT turn-on turn-off delays for DDR2 only\nValid values are:\nMost DDR2 devices utilize a fixed value of 2/2.5. For non-standard SDRAMs, the user must ensure that the operational Write Latency is always greater than or equal to the ODT turn-on delay. For example, a DDR2 SDRAM with CAS latency set to 3 and CAS additive latency set to 0 has a Write Latency of 2. Thus 2/2.5 can be used, but not 3/3.5 or higher.
BitField.name: tAONOFFD

BitField.description: Self refresh exit delay\nThe minimum time between a self refresh exit command and any other command. This parameter must be set to the maximum of the various minimum self refresh exit delay parameters specified in the SDRAM Datasheet, i.e. max(tXSNR, tXSRD) for DDR2 and max(tXS, tXSDLL) for DDR3. Valid values are 2 to\n1023.
BitField.name: tXS

BitField.description: Power down exit delay\nThe minimum time between a power down exit command and any other command. This parameter must be set to the maximum of the various minimum power down exit delay parameters specified in the SDRAM Datasheet, i.e. max(tXP, tXARD, tXARDS) for DDR2 and max(tXP, tXPDLL) for DDR3. Valid values are 2 to 31.
BitField.name: tXP

BitField.description: CKE minimum pulse width\nAlso specifies the minimum time that the SDRAM must remain in power down or self refresh mode. For DDR3 this parameter must be set to the value of tCKESR which is usually bigger than the value of tCKE. Valid values are 2 to 15.
BitField.name: tCKE

BitField.description: DLL locking time\nValid values are 2 to 1023.
BitField.name: tDLLK

BitField.description: Read to ODT delay for DDR3 only\nSpecifies whether ODT can be enabled immediately after the read post-amble or one clock delay has to be added. Valid values are:\nIf tRTODT is set to 1, then the read-to-write latency is increased by 1 if ODT is enabled.
BitField.name: tRTODT

BitField.description: Read to Write command delay\nValid values are:\nThis parameter allows the user to increase the delay between issuing Write commands to the SDRAM when preceded by Read commands. This provides an option to increase bus turn-around margin for high frequency systems.
BitField.name: tRTW

BitField.description: Read to read and write to write command delay\nValid values are:\n
BitField.name: tCCD

BitField.description:
Burst Length
Determines the maximum number of column locations that can be accessed during a given read or write command. Valid values are:
Valid values for DDR3 are:
BitField.name: BL

BitField.description: CAS Latency\nThe delay between when the SDRAM registers a read command to when data is available. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: CL_b0

BitField.description: Burst Type\nIndicates whether a burst is sequential (0) or interleaved (1).
BitField.name: BT

BitField.description: CAS Latency\nThe delay between when the SDRAM registers a read command to when data is available. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: CL_b321

BitField.description: Operating Mode\nSelects either normal operating mode (0) or test mode (1). Test mode is reserved for the manufacturer and should not be used.
BitField.name: TM

BitField.description: DLL Reset\nWriting a '1' to this bit will reset the SDRAM DLL. This bit is self- clearing, i.e. it returns back to '0' after the DLL reset has been issued.
BitField.name: DR

BitField.description:
Write Recovery
This is the value of the write recovery. It is calculated by dividing the Datasheet write recovery time, tWR (ns) by the Datasheet clock cycle time, tCK (ns) and rounding up a non-integer value to the next integer. Valid values are:
All other settings are reserved and should not be used.
Note: tWR (ns) is the time from the first SDRAM positive clock edge after the last data-in pair of a write command, to when a precharge of the same bank can be issued.
BitField.name: WR

BitField.description: Power-Down Control\nControls the exit time for power-down modes. Refer to the SDRAM Datasheet for details on power-down modes. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: PD

BitField.description: DLL Enable/Disable\nEnable (0) or disable (1) the DLL. DLL must be enabled for normal operation.\nNote: SDRAM DLL off mode is not supported
BitField.name: DE

BitField.description: Output Driver Impedance Control\nControls the output drive strength. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: DIC_b0

BitField.description: On Die Termination\nSelects the effective resistance for SDRAM on die termination. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: RTT_b0

BitField.description: Posted CAS Additive Latency\nSetting additive latency that allows read and write commands to be issued to the SDRAM earlier than normal (refer to the SDRAM Datasheet for details). Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: AL

BitField.description: Output Driver Impedance Control\nControls the output drive strength. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: DIC_b1

BitField.description: On Die Termination\nSelects the effective resistance for SDRAM on die termination. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: RTT_b1

BitField.description: Write Leveling Enable\nEnables write-leveling when set.
BitField.name: LEVEL

BitField.description: On Die Termination\nSelects the effective resistance for SDRAM on die termination. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: RTT_b2

BitField.description: Termination Data Strobe\nWhen enabled ('1') TDQS provides additional termination resistance outputs that may be useful in some system configurations. Refer to the SDRAM Datasheet for details.
BitField.name: TDQS

BitField.description: Output Enable/Disable\nWhen '0', all outputs function normal; when '1' all SDRAM outputs are disabled removing output buffer current. This feature is intended to be used for IDD characterization of read current and should not be used in normal operation.
BitField.name: QOFF

BitField.description:
Partial Array Self Refresh
Specifies that data located in areas of the array beyond the specified location will be lost if self refresh is entered.
Valid settings for 4 banks are:
BitField.name: PASR

BitField.description: CAS Write Latency\nThe delay between when the SDRAM registers a write command to when write data is available. Valid values are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: CWL

BitField.description: Auto Self-Refresh\nWhen enabled ('1'), SDRAM automatically provides self-refresh power management functions for all supported operating temperature values. Otherwise the SRT bit must be programmed to indicate the temperature range.
BitField.name: ASR

BitField.description: Self-Refresh Temperature Range\nSelects either normal ('0') or extended ('1') operating temperature range during self-refresh.
BitField.name: SRT

BitField.description: Dynamic ODT\nSelects RTT for dynamic ODT. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: RTTWR

BitField.description: Multi-Purpose Register Location\nSelects MPR data location: Valid value are:\nAll other settings are reserved and should not be used.
BitField.name: MPRLOC

BitField.description: Multi-Purpose Register Enable\nEnables, if set, that read data should come from the Multi-Purpose Register. Otherwise read data come from the DRAM array.
BitField.name: MPR

BitField.description: Read ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a read command is sent to rank n. RDODT0, RDODT1, RDODT2, and RDODT3 specify ODT settings when a read is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to disable ODT during reads.
BitField.name: RDODT0

BitField.description: Read ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a read command is sent to rank n. RDODT0, RDODT1, RDODT2, and RDODT3 specify ODT settings when a read is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to disable ODT during reads.
BitField.name: RDODT1

BitField.description: Read ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a read command is sent to rank n. RDODT0, RDODT1, RDODT2, and RDODT3 specify ODT settings when a read is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to disable ODT during reads.
BitField.name: RDODT2

BitField.description: Read ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a read command is sent to rank n. RDODT0, RDODT1, RDODT2, and RDODT3 specify ODT settings when a read is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to disable ODT during reads.
BitField.name: RDODT3

BitField.description: Write ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a write command is sent to rank n. WRODT0, WRODT1, WRODT2, and WRODT3 specify ODT settings when a write is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to enable ODT only on rank being written to.
BitField.name: WRODT0

BitField.description: Write ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a write command is sent to rank n. WRODT0, WRODT1, WRODT2, and WRODT3 specify ODT settings when a write is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to enable ODT only on rank being written to.
BitField.name: WRODT1

BitField.description: Write ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a write command is sent to rank n. WRODT0, WRODT1, WRODT2, and WRODT3 specify ODT settings when a write is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to enable ODT only on rank being written to.
BitField.name: WRODT2

BitField.description: Write ODT\nSpecifies whether ODT should be enabled ('1') or disabled ('0') on each of the up to four ranks when a write command is sent to rank n. WRODT0, WRODT1, WRODT2, and WRODT3 specify ODT settings when a write is to rank 0, rank 1, rank 2, and rank 3, respectively. The four bits of each field each represent a rank, the LSB being rank 0 and the MSB being rank 3. Default is to enable ODT only on rank being written to.
BitField.name: WRODT3

BitField.description: Data Training Repeat Number\nRepeat number used to confirm stability of DDR write or read.\nNote: The minimum value should be 0x4 and the maximum value should be 0x14.
BitField.name: DTRPTN

BitField.description: Data Training Rank\nSelect the SDRAM rank to be used during Read DQS gate training, Read/Write Data Bit Deskew, Read/Write Eye Training.
BitField.name: DTRANK

BitField.description: Read Data Training Using MPR for DDR3 Only\nSpecifies, if set, that DQS gate training should use the SDRAM Multi-Purpose Register (MPR) register. Otherwise data-training is performed by first writing to some locations in the SDRAM and then reading them back.
BitField.name: DTMPR

BitField.description: Read Data Training Compare Data\nSpecifies, if set, that DQS gate training should also check if the returning read data is correct. Otherwise data-training only checks if the correct number of DQS edges were returned.
BitField.name: DTCMPD

BitField.description: Training WDQ Margin\nDefines how close to 0 or how close to 2*(wdq calibration_value) the WDQ LCDL can be moved during training. Basically defines how much timing margin.
BitField.name: DTWDQM

BitField.description: Data Training Write Bit Deskew Data Mask\nif set, it enables write bit deskew of the data mask
BitField.name: DTWBDDM

BitField.description: Data Training Bit Deskew Centering\nEnables, if set, eye centering capability during write and read bit deskew training.
BitField.name: DTBDC

BitField.description: Data Training WDQ Margin Override\nIf set, the Training WDQ Margin value specified in DTCR[11:8] (DTWDQM) is used during data training. Otherwise the value is computed as ¼ of the ddr_clk period measurement found during calibration of the WDQ LCDL.
BitField.name: DTWDQMO

BitField.description: Data Training Debug Byte Select\nSelects the byte during data training single step debug mode.\nNote: DTDEN is not used to enable this feature.
BitField.name: DTDBS

BitField.description: Data Training Debug Enable\nEnables, if set, the data training single step debug mode.
BitField.name: DTDEN

BitField.description: Data Training Debug Step\nA write of 1 to this bit steps the data training algorithm through a single step. This bit is used to initiate one step of the data training algorithm in question.\nThis bit is self-clearing. To trigger the next step, this bit must be written to again. Note: The training steps must be repeated in order to get new data in the "Data Training Eye Data Register 0-1 (DTEDR0-1)". For example, to see the training results for a different lane, select that lane and repeat the training steps to populate DTEDR0 and DTEDR1 with the correct data.
BitField.name: DTDSTP

BitField.description: Data Training Extended Write DQS\nEnables, if set, an extended write DQS whereby two additional pulses of DQS are added as post-amble to a burst of writes. Generally this should only be enabled when running read bit deskew with the intention of performing read eye deskew prior to running write leveling adjustment.
BitField.name: DTEXD

BitField.description: Rank Enable\nSpecifies the ranks that are enabled for data-training. Bit 0 controls rank 0, bit 1 controls rank 1, bit 2 controls rank 2, and bit 3 controls rank 3. Setting the bit to '1' enables the rank, and setting it to '0' disables the rank.
BitField.name: RANKEN

BitField.description: Refresh During Training\nA non-zero value specifies that a burst of refreshes equal to the number specified in this field should be sent to the SDRAM after training each rank except the last rank.
BitField.name: RFSHDT

BitField.description: Data Training Column Address\nSelects the SDRAM column address to be used during data training. The lower four bits of this address must always be "000".
BitField.name: DTCOL

BitField.description: Data Training Row Address\nSelects the SDRAM row address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTROW

BitField.description: Data Training Bank Address\nSelects the SDRAM bank address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTBANK

BitField.description: Data Training Column Address\nSelects the SDRAM column address to be used during data training. The lower four bits of this address must always be "000".
BitField.name: DTCOL

BitField.description: Data Training Row Address\nSelects the SDRAM row address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTROW

BitField.description: Data Training Bank Address\nSelects the SDRAM bank address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTBANK

BitField.description: Data Training Column Address\nSelects the SDRAM column address to be used during data training. The lower four bits of this address must always be "000".
BitField.name: DTCOL

BitField.description: Data Training Row Address\nSelects the SDRAM row address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTROW

BitField.description: Data Training Bank Address\nSelects the SDRAM bank address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTBANK

BitField.description: Data Training Column Address\nSelects the SDRAM column address to be used during data training. The lower four bits of this address must always be "000".
BitField.name: DTCOL

BitField.description: Data Training Row Address\nSelects the SDRAM row address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTROW

BitField.description: Data Training Bank Address\nSelects the SDRAM bank address to be used during data training.
BitField.name: DTBANK

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe first 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE1

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe first 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE0

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe first 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE2

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe first 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE3

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe second 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE4

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe second 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE5

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe second 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE6

BitField.description: Data Training Data\nThe second 4 bytes of data used during data training. This same data byte is used for each Byte Lane. Default sequence is a walking 1 while toggling data every data cycle.
BitField.name: DTBYTE7

BitField.description: Data Training WDQ LCDL Minimum.
BitField.name: DTWLMN

BitField.description: Data Training WDQ LCDL Maximum.
BitField.name: DTWLMX

BitField.description: Data Training Write BDL Shift Minimum.
BitField.name: DTWBMN

BitField.description: Data Training Write BDL Shift Maximum.
BitField.name: DTWBMX

BitField.description: Data Training RDQS LCDL Minimum.
BitField.name: DTRLMN

BitField.description: Data Training RDQS LCDL Maximum.
BitField.name: DTRLMX

BitField.description: Data Training Read BDL Shift Minimum.
BitField.name: DTRBMN

BitField.description: Data Training Read BDL Shift Maximum.
BitField.name: DTRBMX

BitField.description: Refresh Period\nIndicates the period, after which the PUB has to issue a refresh command to the SDRAM. This is derived from the maximum refresh interval from the Datasheet, tRFC(max) or REFI, divided by the clock cycle time. A further 400 clocks must be subtracted from the derived number to account for command flow and missed slots of refreshes in the internal PUB blocks. The default corresponds to DDR3 9*7.8us at 1066 MHz when a burst of 9 refreshes are issued at every refresh interval.
BitField.name: tREFPRD

BitField.description: No Bubbles\nSpecified whether reads should be returned to the controller with no bubbles. Enabling no-bubble reads increases the read latency. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: NOBUB

BitField.description:
Fixed Latency
Specified whether all reads should be returned to the controller with a fixed read latency. Enabling fixed read latency increases the read latency. Valid values are:
Fixed read latency is calculated as (12 + (maximum DXnGTR.RxDGSL)/2) HDR
clock cycles
BitField.name: FXDLAT

BitField.description: Data Training PUB Mode Timer Exit\nSpecifies the number of controller clocks to wait when entering and exiting pub mode data training. The default value ensures controller refreshes do not cause memory model errors when entering and exiting data training. The value should be increased if controller initiated SDRAM ZQ short or long operation may occur just before or just after the execution of data training.
BitField.name: DTPMXTMR

BitField.description: Shared-AC mode\nSet to 1 to enable shared address/command mode with two independent data channels - available only if shared address/command mode support is compiled in.
BitField.name: SHRAC

BitField.description: AC Power-Down with Dual Channels\nSet to 1 to power-down address/command lane when both data channels are powered-down. Only valid in shared-AC mode.
BitField.name: ACPDDC

BitField.description: Low-Power Master Channel 0 \nSet to 1 to have channel 0 act as master to drive channel 1 low-power functions simultaneously. Only valid in shared-AC mode.
BitField.name: LPMSTRC0

BitField.description: Dynamic AC Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on I/O for ADDR and BA. This bit is ORed with bit ACIOCR[3] (ACPDD).\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: DYNACPDD

BitField.description: Registered DIMM\nIndicates, if set, that a registered DIMM is used. In this case, the PUB increases the SDRAM write and read latencies (WL/RL) by 1 and also enforces that accesses adhere to RDIMM buffer chip. This only applies to PUB internal SDRAM transactions. Transactions generated by the controller must make its own adjustments to WL/RL when using a registered DIMM. The DCR.NOSRA register bit must be set to '1' if using the standard RDIMM buffer chip so that normal DRAM accesses do not assert multiple chip select bits at the same time.
BitField.name: RDIMM

BitField.description: Parity Error No Registering\nIndicates, if set, that parity error signal from the RDIMM should be passed to the DFI controller without any synchronization or registering.
BitField.name: ERRNOREG

BitField.description: Stop On Parity Error\nIndicates, if set, that the PUB is to stop driving commands to the DRAM upon encountering a parity error. Transactions can resume only after status is cleared via PIR.CLRSR.
BitField.name: SOPERR

BitField.description: PAR_IN On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for PAR_IN pin.
BitField.name: PARINODT

BitField.description: PAR_IN Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for PAR_IN pin.
BitField.name: PARINPDD

BitField.description: PAR_IN Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for PAR_IN pin.
BitField.name: PARINPDR

BitField.description: PAR_IN I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for PAR_IN pin.
BitField.name: PARINIOM

BitField.description: PAR_IN Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for PAR_IN pin.
BitField.name: PARINOE

BitField.description: ERROUT# On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for ERROUT# pin.
BitField.name: ERROUTODT

BitField.description: ERROUT# Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for ERROUT# pin.
BitField.name: ERROUTPDD

BitField.description: ERROUT# Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for ERROUT# pin.
BitField.name: ERROUTPDR

BitField.description: ERROUT# I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for ERROUT# pin.
BitField.name: ERROUTIOM

BitField.description: ERROUT# Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for ERROUT# pin.
BitField.name: ERROUTOE

BitField.description: RDIMM Outputs On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for QCSEN# and MIRROR pins.
BitField.name: RDIMMODT

BitField.description: RDIMM Outputs Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on the I/O for QCSEN# and MIRROR pins.
BitField.name: RDIMMPDD

BitField.description: RDIMM Outputs Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on the I/O for QCSEN# and MIRROR pins.
BitField.name: RDIMMPDR

BitField.description: RDIMM Outputs I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for QCSEN# and MIRROR pins.
BitField.name: RDIMMIOM

BitField.description: QCSEN# Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for QCSEN# pin.
BitField.name: QCSENOE

BitField.description: MIRROR Output Enable\nEnables, when set, the output driver on the I/O for MIRROR pin.
BitField.name: MIRROROE

BitField.description: RDMIMM Quad CS Enable\nEnables, if set, the Quad CS mode for the RDIMM registering buffer chip. This register bit controls the buffer chip QCSEN# signal.
BitField.name: QCSEN

BitField.description: RDIMM Mirror\nSelects between two different ballouts of the RDIMM buffer chip for front or back operation. This register bit controls the buffer chip MIRROR signal.
BitField.name: MIRROR

BitField.description: Stabilization time\nNumber of DRAM clock cycles for the RDIMM buffer chip to stabilize. This parameter corresponds to the buffer chip tSTAB parameter. Default value is in decimal format and corresponds to 6us at 533 MHz.
BitField.name: tBCSTAB

BitField.description: Command word to command word programming delay\nNumber of DRAM clock cycles between two RDIMM buffer chip command programming accesses. The value used for tBCMRD is 8 plus the value programmed in these bits, i.e. tBCMRD value ranges from 8 to 15. This parameter corresponds to the buffer chip tMRD parameter.
BitField.name: tBCMRD

BitField.description: Control Registers Initialization Enable\nIndicates which RDIMM buffer chip control registers (RC0 to RC15) should be initialized (written) when the PUB is triggered to initialize the buffer chip. A setting of '1' on CRINIT[n] bit means that CRn should be written during initialization.
BitField.name: CRINIT

BitField.description: Control Word 0 for Global Features Control Word\nBit definitions are: \n
BitField.name: RC0

BitField.description: Control Word 1 for Clock Driver Enable Control Word\nBit definitions are: \n
BitField.name: RC1

BitField.description: Control Word 2 for Timing Control Word\nBit definitions are:\n
BitField.name: RC2

BitField.description: Control Word 3 for Command/Address Signals Driver Characteristics Control Word\nRC3[1:0] is driver settings for command/address A outputs, and RC3[3:2] is driver settings for command/address B outputs. Bit definitions are:\n
BitField.name: RC3

BitField.description: Control Word 4 for Control Signals Driver Characteristics Control Word\nRC4[1:0] is driver settings for control A outputs, and RC4[3:2] is driver settings for control B outputs. Bit definitions are:\n
BitField.name: RC4

BitField.description: Control Word 5 for CK Driver Characteristics Control Word\nRC5[1:0] is driver settings for clock Y1, Y1#, Y3, and Y3# outputs, and RC5[3:2] is driver settings for clock Y0, Y0#, Y2, and Y2# outputs. Bit definitions are:\n
BitField.name: RC5

BitField.description: Control Word 6\nReserved, free to use by vendor.
BitField.name: RC6

BitField.description: Control Word 7\nReserved, free to use by vendor.
BitField.name: RC7

BitField.description: Control Word 8 for Additional Input Bus Termination Setting Control Word\nRC8[2:0] is Input Bus Termination (IBT) setting as follows:\n
BitField.name: RC8

BitField.description: Control Word 9 for Power Saving Settings Control Word\nBit definitions are: \n
BitField.name: RC9

BitField.description: Control Word 10 for RDIMM Operating Speed Control Word\nRC10[2:0] is RDIMM operating speed setting as follows:\nRC10[3]: Don't care.
BitField.name: RC10

BitField.description: Control Word 11 for Operating Voltage VDD Control Word\nRC10[1:0] is VDD operating voltage setting as follows:\nRC10[3:2]: Reserved.
BitField.name: RC11

BitField.description: Control Word 12\nReserved for future use.
BitField.name: RC12

BitField.description: Control Word 13\nReserved for future use.
BitField.name: RC13

BitField.description: Control Word 14\nReserved for future use
BitField.name: RC14

BitField.description: Control Word 15\nReserved for future use
BitField.name: RC15

BitField.description: Cache Word Address\nAddress of the cache word to be accessed.
BitField.name: CWADDR

BitField.description: Cache Slice Address\nAddress of the cache slice to be accessed.
BitField.name: CSADDR

BitField.description: Cache Select\nSelects the cache to be accessed. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: CSEL

BitField.description: Increment Address\nSpecifies, if set, that the cache address specified in WADDR and SADDR should be automatically incremented after each access of the cache. The increment happens in such a way that all the slices of a selected word are first accessed before going to the next word.
BitField.name: INCA

BitField.description: Access Type\nSpecifies the type of access to be performed using this address. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: ATYPE

BitField.description: Cache Data\nData to be written to or read from a cache. This data corresponds to the cache word slice specified by the DCU Address Register.
BitField.name: CDATA

BitField.description: DCU Instruction\nSelects the DCU command to be executed: Valid values are:\n0101 - 1111 Reserved
BitField.name: DINST

BitField.description: Start Address\nCache word address where the execution of commands should begin.
BitField.name: SADDR

BitField.description: End Address\nCache word address where the execution of command should end.
BitField.name: EADDR

BitField.description: Number of Failures\nSpecifies the number of failures after which the execution of commands and the capture of read data should stop if SONF bit of this register is set. Execution of commands and the capture of read data will stop after (NFAIL+1) failures if SONF is set.\nValid values are from 0 to 254.
BitField.name: NFAIL

BitField.description: Stop On Nth Fail\nSpecifies, if set, that the execution of commands and the capture of read data should stop when there are N read data failures. The number of failures is specified by NFAIL. Otherwise commands execute until the end of the program or until manually stopped using a STOP command.
BitField.name: SONF

BitField.description: Stop Capture On Full\nSpecifies, if set, that the capture of read data should stop when the capture cache is full.
BitField.name: SCOF

BitField.description: Read Capture Enable\nIndicates, if set, that read data coming back from the SDRAM should be captured into the read data cache.
BitField.name: RCEN

BitField.description: Expected Compare Enable\nIndicates, if set, that read data coming back from the SDRAM should be should be compared with the expected data.
BitField.name: XCEN

BitField.description: Loop Start Address\nCommand cache word address where the loop should start.
BitField.name: LSADDR

BitField.description: Loop End Address\nCommand cache word address where the loop should end.
BitField.name: LEADDR

BitField.description: Loop Count\nThe number of times that the loop should be executed if LINF is not set.
BitField.name: LCNT

BitField.description: Loop Infinite\nIndicates, if set, that the loop should be executed indefinitely until stopped by the STOP command. Otherwise the loop is execute LCNT times.
BitField.name: LINF

BitField.description: Increment DRAM Address\nIndicates, if set, that DRAM addresses should be incremented every time a DRAM read/write command inside the loop is executed.
BitField.name: IDA

BitField.description:
Expected Data Loop End Address
The last expected data cache word address that contains valid expected data. Expected data should be looped between 0 and this address.
XLEADDR field uses only the following bits based on the cache depth:
BitField.name: XLEADDR

BitField.description: Read Capture Start Word\nThe capture and compare of read data should start after Nth word. For example setting this value to 12 will skip the first 12 read data.
BitField.name: RCSW

BitField.description: DCU Generic Timing Parameter 0
BitField.name: tDCUT0

BitField.description: DCU Generic Timing Parameter 1
BitField.name: tDCUT1

BitField.description: DCU Generic Timing Parameter 2
BitField.name: tDCUT2

BitField.description: DCU Generic Timing Parameter 3
BitField.name: tDCUT3

BitField.description: Run Done\nIndicates, if set, that the DCU has finished executing the commands in the command cache. This bit is also set to indicate that a STOP command has successfully been executed and command execution has stopped.
BitField.name: RDONE

BitField.description: Capture Fail\nIndicates, if set, that at least one read data word has failed.
BitField.name: CFAIL

BitField.description: Capture Full\nIndicates, if set, that the capture cache is full.
BitField.name: CFULL

BitField.description: Read Count\nNumber of read words returned from the SDRAM.
BitField.name: RDCNT

BitField.description: Fail Count\nNumber of read words that have failed.
BitField.name: FLCNT

BitField.description: Loop Count\nIndicates the value of the loop count. This is useful when the program has stopped because of failures to assess how many reads were executed before first fail.
BitField.name: LPCNT

BitField.description:
Anti-Aging Toggle Rate
Defines the number of controller clock (ctl_clk) cycles after which the PUB will toggle the data going to DATX8 if the data channel between the controller/PUB and DATX8 has been idle for this long.
The default value corresponds to a toggling count of 4096 ctl_clk cycles. For a ctl_clk running at 533 MHz the toggle rate will be approximately 7.68us.
The default value may also be overridden by the macro
DWC_AACR_AATR_DFLT.
BitField.name: AATR

BitField.description: Anti-Aging Enable Control\nEnables, if set, the automatic toggling of the data going to the DATX8 when the data channel from the controller/PUB to DATX8 is idle for programmable number of clock cycles.
BitField.name: AAENC

BitField.description: Anti-Aging PAD Output Enable Control\nEnables, if set, anti-aging toggling on the pad output enable signal "ctl_oe_n" going into the DATX8s. This will increase power consumption for the anti-aging feature.
BitField.name: AAOENC

BitField.description: General Purpose Register 0\nGeneral purpose register bits.
BitField.name: GPR0

BitField.description: General Purpose Register 1\nGeneral purpose register bits.
BitField.name: GPR1

BitField.description:
Impedance Over-Ride Data
Data used to directly drive the impedance control.
ZDATA field mapping for D3R I/O is as follows: 
ZDATA[27:20] is reserved and returns zeros on reads.
ZDATA[19:15] is used to select the pull-up on-die termination impedance. 
ZDATA[14:10] is used to select the pull-down on-die termination impedance. 
ZDATA[9:5] is used to select the pull-up output impedance
ZDATA[4:0] is used to select the pull-down output impedance.
Note: The default value is 0x000014A for I/O type D3R.
BitField.name: ZDATA

BitField.description: Impedance Over-Ride Enable\nWhen this bit is set, it allows users to directly drive the impedance control using the data programmed in the ZDATA field. Otherwise, the control is generated automatically by the impedance control logic.
BitField.name: ZDEN

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Bypass\nBypasses, if set, impedance calibration of this ZQ control block when impedance calibration is already in progress. Impedance calibration can be disabled prior to trigger by using the ZCALEN bit.
BitField.name: ZCALBYP

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Enable\nEnables, if set, the impedance calibration of this ZQ control block when impedance calibration is triggered using either the ZCAL bit of PIR register or the DFI update interface.
BitField.name: ZCALEN

BitField.description: ZQ Power Down\nPowers down, if set, the PZQ cell.
BitField.name: ZQPD

BitField.description: Impedance Divide Ratio\nSelects the external resistor divide ratio to be used to set the output impedance and the on-die termination as follows:\n
BitField.name: ZPROG

BitField.description: DFI Controller Update Interface 0\nSets this impedance controller to be enabled for calibration when the DFI controller update interface 0 (channel 0) requests an update.
BitField.name: DFICU0

BitField.description: DFI Controller Update Interface 1\nSets this impedance controller to be enabled for calibration when the DFI controller update interface 1 (channel 1) requests an update. Only valid in shared-AC mode.
BitField.name: DFICU1

BitField.description: DFI Concurrent Controller Update Interface\nSets this impedance controller to be enabled for calibration when both of the DFI controller update interfaces request an update on the same clock. This provides the ability to enable impedance calibration updates for the Address/Command lane. Only valid in shared-AC mode.
BitField.name: DFICCU

BitField.description: DFI Update Interface 0\nSets this impedance controller to be enabled for calibration when the DFI PHY update interface 0 (channel 0) requests an update.
BitField.name: DFIPU0

BitField.description: DFI Update Interface 1\nSets this impedance controller to be enabled for calibration when the DFI PHY update interface 1 (channel 1) requests an update. Only valid in shared-AC mode.
BitField.name: DFIPU1

BitField.description:
Impedance Control
Current value of impedance control. 
ZCTRL field mapping for D3R I/O is as follows: 
ZCTRL[27:20] is reserved and returns zeros on reads.
ZCTRL[19:15] is used to select the pull-up on-die termination impedance. 
ZCTRL[14:10] is used to select the pull-down on-die termination impedance. 
ZCTRL[9:5] is used to select the pull-up output impedance.
ZCTRL[4:0] is used to select the pull-down output impedance.
Note: The default value is 0x000014A for I/O type D3R.
BitField.name: ZCTRL

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Error\nIf set, indicates that there was an error during impedance calibration.
BitField.name: ZERR

BitField.description: Impedance Calibration Done\nIndicates that impedance calibration has completed.
BitField.name: ZDONE

BitField.description: Output impedance pull-down calibration status\nValid status encodings are:\n
BitField.name: ZPD

BitField.description: Output impedance pull-up calibration status\nSimilar status encodings as ZPD.
BitField.name: ZPU

BitField.description: On-die termination pull-down calibration status\nSimilar status encodings as ZPD.
BitField.name: OPD

BitField.description: On-die termination pull-up calibration status\nSimilar status encodings as ZPD.
BitField.name: OPU

Register.description: DATX8 General Configuration Register for Byte Lane0
Register.name: DX0GCR

BitField.description: Data Byte Enable\nEnables, if set, the data byte. Setting this bit to '0' disables the byte, i.e. the byte is not used in PHY initialization or training and is ignored during SDRAM read/write operations.
BitField.name: DXEN

BitField.description: DQS On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for DQS/DQS# pin of the byte. This bit is ORed with the common DATX8 ODT configuration bit (see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)").\nNote: This bit is only valid when DXnGCR0[9] is '0'.
BitField.name: DQSODT

BitField.description: Data On-Die Termination\nEnables, when set, the on-die termination on the I/O for DQ and DM pins of the byte. This bit is ORed with the common DATX8 ODT configuration bit (see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)").\nNote: This bit is only valid when DXnGCR0[10] is '0'.
BitField.name: DQODT

BitField.description: Data I/O Mode\nSelects SSTL mode (when set to 0) or CMOS mode (when set to 1) of the I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of the byte. This bit is ORed with the IOM configuration bit of the individual DATX8(see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)").
BitField.name: DXIOM

BitField.description: Data Power Down Driver\nPowers down, when set, the output driver on I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of the byte. This bit is ORed with the common PDD configuration bit (see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)").\nNote: Asserting PDD puts the I/O driver cell into a lower power, lower speed mode of operation. However, it will still drive if its OE is asserted. ODT will be disabled (if used). Asserting PDD does not prevent the I/O from driving.
BitField.name: DXPDD

BitField.description: Data Power Down Receiver\nPowers down, when set, the input receiver on I/O for DQ, DM, and DQS/DQS# pins of the byte. This bit is ORed with the common PDR configuration bit (see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)").
BitField.name: DXPDR

BitField.description: DQSR Power Down\nPowers down, if set, the PDQSR cell. This bit is ORed with the common PDR configuration bit (see "DATX8 Common Configuration Register (DXCCR)")
BitField.name: DQSRPD

BitField.description: Write DQS Enable\nControls whether the write DQS going to the SDRAM is enabled (toggling) or disabled (static value) and whether the DQS is inverted. DQS# is always the inversion of DQS. These values are valid only when DQS/DQS# output enable is on, otherwise the DQS/DQS# is tristated. Valid settings are:\n
BitField.name: DSEN

BitField.description: DQS Dynamic RTT Control\nIf set, the on die termination (ODT) control of the DQS/DQS# SSTL I/O is dynamically generated to enable the ODT during read operation and disabled otherwise. By setting this bit to '0' the dynamic ODT feature is disabled. To control ODT statically this bit must be set to '0' and DXnGCR0[1] (DQSODT) is used to enable ODT (when set to '1') or disable ODT(when set to '0').
BitField.name: DQSRTT

BitField.description: DQ Dynamic RTT Control\nIf set, the on die termination (ODT) control of the DQ/DM SSTL I/O is dynamically generated to enable the ODT during read operation and disabled otherwise. By setting this bit to '0' the dynamic ODT feature is disabled. To control ODT statically this bit must be set to '0' and DXnGCR0[2] (DQODT) is used to enable ODT (when set to '1') or disable ODT(when set to '0').
BitField.name: DQRTT

BitField.description: RTT Output Hold\nIndicates the number of clock cycles (from 0 to 3) after the read data postamble for which ODT control should remain set to DQSODT for DQS or DQODT for DQ/DM before disabling it (setting it to '0') when using dynamic ODT control. ODT is disabled almost RTTOH clock cycles after the read postamble.
BitField.name: RTTOH

BitField.description: RTT On Additive Latency\nIndicates when the ODT control of DQ/DQS SSTL I/Os is set to the value in DQODT/DQSODT during read cycles. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: RTTOAL

BitField.description: Data Byte Output Enable Override\nSpecifies whether the output I/O output enable for the byte lane should be set to a fixed value. Valid values are:\n
BitField.name: DXOEO

BitField.description: PLL Rest\nResets the byte PLL by driving the PLL reset pin. This bit is not self- clearing and a '0' must be written to de-assert the reset. This bit is ORed with the global PLLRST configuration bit.
BitField.name: PLLRST

BitField.description: PLL Power Down\nPuts the byte PLL in Power-down mode by driving the PLL power down pin. This bit is not self-clearing and a '0' must be written to de-assert the power-down. This bit is ORed with the global PLLPD configuration bit.
BitField.name: PLLPD

BitField.description: Gear Shift\nEnables, if set, rapid locking mode on the byte PLL. This bit is ORed with the global GSHIFT configuration bit.
BitField.name: GSHIFT

BitField.description: PLL Bypass\nPuts the byte PLL in bypass mode by driving the PLL bypass pin. This bit is not self-clearing and a '0' must be written to de-assert the bypass. This bit is ORed with the global BYP configuration bit.
BitField.name: PLLBYP

BitField.description: Write Level Rank Enable\nSpecifies the ranks that should be write leveled for this byte. Write leveling responses from ranks that are not enabled for write leveling for a particular byte are ignored and write leveling is flagged as done for these ranks. WLRKEN[0] enables rank 0, [1] enables rank 1, [2] enables rank 2, and [3] enables rank 3.
BitField.name: WLRKEN

BitField.description: Master Delay Line Enable\nEnables, if set, the DATX8 master delay line calibration to perform subsequent period measurements following the initial period measurements that are performed after reset or when calibration is manually triggered. These additional measurements are accumulated and filtered as long as this bit remains high. This bit is ANDed with the common DATX8 MDL enable bit.
BitField.name: MDLEN

BitField.description: Calibration Bypass\nPrevents, if set, period measurement calibration from automatically triggering after PHY initialization.
BitField.name: CALBYP

Register.name: DX0GSR0

BitField.description: Write DQ Calibration\nIndicates, if set, that the DATX8 has finished doing period measurement calibration for the write DQ LCDL.
BitField.name: WDQCAL

BitField.description: Read DQS Calibration\nIndicates, if set, that the DATX8 has finished doing period measurement calibration for the read DQS LCDL.
BitField.name: RDQSCAL

BitField.description: Read DQS# Calibration for Type B/B1 PHY Only\nIndicates, if set, that the DATX8 has finished doing period measurement calibration for the read DQS# LCDL.
