BitField.description: Current release number\nThis field indicates the Synopsys DesignWare Cores DWC_mshc/DWC_mshc_lite current release number that is read by an application. \nAn application reading this register in conjunction with the MSHC_VER_TYPE_R register, gathers details of the current release.
BitField.name: MSHC_VER_ID

BitField.description: Current release type\nThis field indicates the Synopsys DesignWare Cores DWC_mshc/DWC_mshc_lite current release type that is read by an application. \nAn application reading this register in conjunction with the MSHC_VER_ID_R register, gathers details of the current release.
BitField.name: MSHC_VER_TYPE

BitField.description:
Command conflict check 
This bit enables command conflict check. 
Note: DWC_mshc controller monitors the CMD line whenever a command is issued and checks whether the value driven on sd_cmd_out matches the value on sd_cmd_in at next subsequent edge of cclk_tx to determine command conflict error. This bit is cleared only if the feed back delay (including I/O Pad delay) is more than (t_card_clk_period - t_setup), where t_setup is the setup time of a flop in DWC_mshc. The I/O pad delay is consistent across CMD and DATA lines, and it is within the value:
(2*t_card_clk_period - t_setup)
BitField.name: CMD_CONFLICT_CHECK

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD1) of the MSHC_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSVD1

BitField.description: Internal clock gating disable control \nThis bit must be used to disable IP's internal clock gating when required. when disabled clocks are not gated. Clocks to the core (except hclk) must be stopped when programming this bit.
BitField.name: SW_CG_DIS

BitField.description: Undefined INCR Burst \nControls generation of undefined length INCR transfer on Master interface.
BitField.name: UNDEFL_INCR_EN

BitField.description: INCR4 Burst \nControls generation of INCR4 transfers on Master interface.
BitField.name: BURST_INCR4_EN

BitField.description: INCR8 Burst \nControls generation of INCR8 transfers on Master interface.
BitField.name: BURST_INCR8_EN

BitField.description: INCR16 Burst \nControls generation of INCR16 transfers on Master interface.
BitField.name: BURST_INCR16_EN

BitField.description: eMMC Card present\nThis bit indicates the type of card connected. An application program this bit based on the card connected to MSHC.
BitField.name: CARD_IS_EMMC

BitField.description: Disable Data CRC Check\nThis bit controls masking of CRC16 error for Card Write in eMMC mode. This is useful in bus testing (CMD19) for an eMMC device. In bus testing, an eMMC card does not send CRC status for a block, which may generate CRC error. This CRC error can be masked using this bit during bus testing.
BitField.name: DISABLE_DATA_CRC_CHK

BitField.description: EMMC Device Reset signal control\nThis register field controls the sd_rst_n output of DWC_mshc
BitField.name: EMMC_RST_N

BitField.description: Output Enable control for EMMC Device Reset signal PAD control\nThis field drived sd_rst_n_oe output of DWC_mshc
BitField.name: EMMC_RST_N_OE

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD) of the EMMC_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSVD

BitField.description: Mandatory Boot Enable\nThis bit is used to initiate the mandatory boot operation. The application sets this bit along with VALIDATE_BOOT bit. Writing 0 is ignored. The DWC_mshc clears this bit after the boot transfer is completed or terminated.\n
BitField.name: MAN_BOOT_EN

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD _6_1) of the BOOT_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_6_1

BitField.description: Validate Mandatory Boot Enable bit\nThis bit is used to validate the MAN_BOOT_EN bit.
BitField.name: VALIDATE_BOOT

BitField.description: Boot Acknowledge Enable\nWhen this bit set, DWC_mshc checks for boot acknowledge start pattern of 0-1-0 during boot operation. This bit is applicable for both mandatory and alternate boot mode.
BitField.name: BOOT_ACK_ENABLE

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD_11_9) of the BOOT_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_11_9

BitField.description: Boot Ack Timeout Counter Value \nThis value determines the interval by which boot ack timeout (50 ms) is detected when boot ack is expected during boot operation. \n
BitField.name: BOOT_TOUT_CNT

BitField.description: Setting this bit enables Auto tuning engine This bit is enabled by default when core is configured with mode3 retuning support Clear this bit to 0 when core is configured to have Mode3 re-tuning but SW wishes to disable mode3 re-tuning \nThis field should be programmed only when CLK_CTRL_R.SD_CLK_EN is 0. \n
BitField.name: AT_EN

BitField.description: Select the interval when the corrected center phase select code can be driven on tuning_cclk_sel output.\n
BitField.name: CI_SEL

BitField.description:
Sampling window Threshold enable 
Selects the tuning mode 
Field should be programmed only when SAMPLE_CLK_SEL is '0'
BitField.name: SWIN_TH_EN

BitField.description: Framing errors are not generated when executing tuning. This debug bit allows users to report these errors.\n
BitField.name: RPT_TUNE_ERR

BitField.description: Enable software-managed tuning flow\n
BitField.name: SW_TUNE_EN

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD2) of the AT_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSDV2

BitField.description: This field sets the phase for Left and Right edges for drift monitoring [Left edge offset + Right edge offset] must not be less than total taps of delayLine.\n
BitField.name: WIN_EDGE_SEL

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD3) of the AT_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSDV3

BitField.description: Clock stopping control for Tuning and auto-tuning circuit \nWhen enabled, clock gate control output of DWC_mshc (clk2card_on) is pulled low before changing phase select codes on tuning_cclk_sel and autotuning_cclk_sel. This effectively stops the Device/Card clock, cclk_rx and also drift_cclk_rx. Changing phase code when clocks are stopped ensures glitch free phase switching. Set this bit to 0 if the PHY or delayline can guarantee glitch free switching.\n
BitField.name: TUNE_CLK_STOP_EN

BitField.description: Maximum Latency specification between cclk_tx and cclk_rx \n
BitField.name: PRE_CHANGE_DLY

BitField.description: Time taken for phase switching and stable clock output\nSpecifies the maximum time (in terms of cclk cycles) that the delay line can take to switch its output phase after a change in tuning_cclk_sel or autotuning_cclk_sel. \n
BitField.name: POST_CHANGE_DLY

BitField.description:
Sampling window threshold value setting
The maximum value that can be set here depends on the length of delayline used for tuning. A delayLine with 128 taps can use values from 0x0 to 0x7F.
This field is valid only when SWIN_TH_EN is '1'. Should be programmed only when SAMPLE_CLK_SEL is '0'
BitField.name: SWIN_TH_VAL

BitField.description: Centered Phase code \nReading this field returns the current value on tuning_cclk_sel output Setting AT_CTRL_R.SW_TUNE_EN enables software to write to this field and its contents are reflected on tuning_cclk_sel.\n
BitField.name: CENTER_PH_CODE

BitField.description: Right Edge Phase code \nReading this field returns the phase code value used by Auto-tuning engine to sample data on Right edge of sampling window.
BitField.name: R_EDGE_PH_CODE

BitField.description: Left Edge Phase code \nReading this field returns the phase code value used by Auto-tuning engine to sample data on Left edge of sampling window.
BitField.name: L_EDGE_PH_CODE

BitField.description: These bits of the AT_STAT_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSDV1

BitField.description: Number of Clock Pins\nThis field indicates support of clock pins to select one of devices for shared bus system. Up to 7 clock pins can be supported. \nNote: SD Mode.
BitField.name: NUM_CLK_PIN

BitField.description: This bit (RSVD_3) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register is reserved and always returns 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_3

BitField.description: Number of Interrupt Input Pins \nThis field indicates support of interrupt input pins for an embedded system.
BitField.name: NUM_INT_PIN

BitField.description: These bits (RSVD_7_6) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register are reserved and always return 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_7_6

BitField.description: Bus Width Preset\nEach bit of this field specifies the bus width for each embedded device. The shared bus supports mixing of 4-bit and 8-bit bus width devices. \nNote: SD Mode.
BitField.name: BUS_WIDTH_PRESET

BitField.description: This bit (RSVD_15) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register is reserved and always returns 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_15

BitField.description: Clock Pin Select \nThis bit is selected by one of clock pin outputs. \nNote: SD Mode.
BitField.name: CLK_PIN_SEL

BitField.description: This bit (RSVD_19) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register is reserved and always returns 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_19

BitField.description: Interrupt Pin Select \nThese bits enable the interrupt pin inputs. \n
BitField.name: INT_PIN_SEL

BitField.description: This bit (RSVD_23) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register is reserved and always returns 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_23

BitField.description: Back-End Power Control \nEach bit of this field controls back-end power supply for an embedded device. \nNote: SD Mode
BitField.name: BACK_END_PWR_CTRL

BitField.description: This bit (RSVD_31) of the EMBEDDED_CTRL_R register is reserved and always returns 0.
BitField.name: RSVD_31

BitField.description: NFI Embedded Buffer Word n\nThis field indicates a 32-bit data of NAND Flash controller embedded buffer.
BitField.name: Data

Register.description: NFI DMA Control and Status Register
Register.name: NFI_DMACTL

BitField.description: DMA Controller Engine Enable Bit\nNote 1: If this bit is cleared, DMA will ignore all requests from NAND Flash and force bus master into IDLE state.\nNote 2: If target abort occurred, DMACEN will be cleared.
BitField.name: DMACEN

BitField.description: Software Engine Reset\nNote: The software reset DMA related registers.
BitField.name: DMARST

BitField.description: Scatter-gather Function for NFI Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: SGEN

BitField.description: NFI DMA Transfer in Progress\nThis bit indicates if NFI is granted and doing DMA transfer or not.\n
BitField.name: DMABUSY

Register.description: NFI DMA Transfer Starting Address Register
Register.name: NFI_DMASA

BitField.description: Determined to the PAD Table Fetching Is in Order or Out of Order\n
BitField.name: ORDER

BitField.description:
DMA Transfer Starting Address
This field pads 0 as least significant bit indicates a 32-bit starting address of system memory (SRAM) for DMA to retrieve or fill in data.
If DMA is not in normal mode, this field will be interpreted as a starting address of Physical Address Descriptor (PAD) table.
Note: Starting address of the SRAM must be word aligned, for example, 0x0000_0000, 0x0000_0004.
BitField.name: DMASA

Register.description: NFI DMA Transfer Byte Count Register
Register.name: NFI_DMABCNT

BitField.description: DMA Transfer Byte Count (Read Only)\nThis field indicates the remained byte count of DMA transfer. The value of this field is valid only when NFI is busy; otherwise, it is zero.
BitField.name: BCNT

Register.description: NFI DMA Interrupt Enable Control Register
Register.name: NFI_DMAINTEN

BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: ABORTIEN

BitField.description: Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: WEOTIEN

BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote 1: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.\nNote 2: When DMA's bus master received ERROR response, it means that target abort happened. DMA will stop transfer and respond this event by set ABORTIF high. Then, NFI go to IDLE state. When target abort occurred or WEOTIF is set, it is necessary to reset NFI's DMA and then transfer those data again.
BitField.name: ABORTIF

BitField.description: Wrong EOT Encountered Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nWhen DMA Scatter-Gather function is enabled, and EOT of the descriptor is encountered before DMA transfer finished (that means the total sector count of all PAD is less than the sector count of NFI), this bit will be set.\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: WEOTIF

Register.description: NFI Global Control and Status Register
Register.name: NFI_GCTL

BitField.description: Software Engine Reset\nNote: The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will auto cleared after a few clock cycles.
BitField.name: GCTLRST

BitField.description: NAND Flash Functionality Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: NANDEN

BitField.description: DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: DTAIEN

BitField.description: DMA READ/WRITE Target Abort Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit indicates DMA received an ERROR response from internal AHB bus during DMA read/write operation. When Target Abort occurred, please reset all engines.\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: DTAIF

BitField.description: Software Engine Reset\nNote: The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will be auto cleared after a few clock cycles.
BitField.name: SWRST

BitField.description: DMA Read Data Enable Bit\nThis bit enables NAND controller to transfer data (1 page) from NAND Flash or NAND type Flash into DMAC's embedded frame buffer.\nNote: When DMA transfer completed, this bit will be cleared automatically.
BitField.name: DRDEN

BitField.description: DMA Write Data Enable Bit \nThis bit enables NAND controller to transfer data (1 page) from DMAC's embedded frame buffer into NAND Flash or NAND type Flash.\nNote: When DMA transfer completed, this bit will be cleared automatically.
BitField.name: DWREN

BitField.description: Redundant Area Read Enable Bit \nThis bit enables NAND controller to transfer redundant data from NAND Flash into NFI_NANDRA, the data size is dependent on NFI_NANDRACTL register.\nNote: When transfer completed, this bit will be cleared automatically.
BitField.name: REDUNREN

BitField.description: Redundant Area Auto Write Enable Bit\nThis field is used to auto write redundant data out to NAND Flash. The redundant data area is dependent on NFI_NANDRACTL register.\n
BitField.name: REDUNAUTOWEN

BitField.description: None Used Field ECC Check After Read Page Data\n
BitField.name: ECCCHK

BitField.description: Protect_3Byte Software Data Enable Bit\nThe ECC algorithm only protects data area and hardware ECC parity code. User can choose to protect software redundant data first 3 bytes by setting this bit high.\n
BitField.name: PROT3BEN

BitField.description: SRAM Initial\nNote: The contents of control register will not be cleared. This bit will be auto cleared after a few clock cycles.
BitField.name: SRAMINT

BitField.description: Page Size of NAND\nThis bit indicates the page size of NAND. There are four page sizes for choose, 2048 bytes/page, 4096 bytes/page and 8192 bytes/page. Before setting PSIZE register, user must set BCHTSEL register at first.\n
BitField.name: PSIZE

BitField.description: BCH Correct Bit Selection\nThis field is used to select BCH correct bits for data protecting. For BCH algorithm, T can be 8 or 12 or 24 for choosing (correct 8 or 12 or 24 bits).\n
BitField.name: BCHTSEL

BitField.description:
ECC Algorithm Enable Bit
This field is used to select the ECC algorithm for data protecting. The BCH algorithm can correct 8 or 12 or 24 bits.
Note 1: If disabling ECCEN and when reading data from NAND, the NAND controller will ignore its ECC check result. When writing data to NAND, the NAND controller will write out 0xFF to every parity field.
Note 2: The ECC algorithm only protects data area and hardware ECC parity code by default. By setting PROT3BEN (NFI_NANDCTL[8]) high, the first 3 bytes of redundant data are also protected by ECC algorithm.
BitField.name: ECCEN

BitField.description: NAND Flash Chip Select 0 Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: CS0

BitField.description: NAND Flash Chip Select 1 Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: CS1

BitField.description: Read/Write Enable Signal Low Pulse Width\nThis field controls the low pulse width of signals -RE and -WE while HARDWARE mode page access is enabled. The pulse width is a multiple of period of AHB bus clock. ( The actual width time will be [clock period*(LOWID+1)] )
BitField.name: LOWID

BitField.description: Read/Write Enable Signal High Pulse Width\nThis field controls the high pulse width of signals -RE and -WE while HARDWARE mode page access is enabled. The pulse width is a multiple of period of AHB bus clock. ( The actual width time will be [clock period*(HIWID+1)] )
BitField.name: HIWID

BitField.description:
CLE/ALE Setup/Hold Time
This field controls the CLE/ALE setup/hold time to -WE.
The setup/hold time can be calculated using following equation:
BitField.name: CALESH

BitField.description:
EDO Mode Delay Time
Control this field to delay sampling point when NAND Flash enters EDO mode only.
The EDO mode delay time can be calculated using following equation:
BitField.name: EDOD

BitField.description: EDO Mode Enable Bit\nThis bit specifies NAND Flash to EDO mode. Before trigger this bit, software should fill EDOD(NFI_NANDTMCTL[27:24]), CALESH(NFI_NANDTMCTL[22:16]), HIWID(NFI_NANDTMCTL[15:8]) and LOWID(NFI_NANDTMCTL[7:0]).\nNote: Only NAND Flash entering EDO mode should set this bit.
BitField.name: EDOEN

BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Data Complete Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: DMAIE

BitField.description: ECC Field Check Error Interrupt Enable Bit \nThis bit can check the ECC error on each field (512bytes) of data transfer. Enable this bit to detect error and do error correction.\n
BitField.name: ECCFLDIE

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 0 Rising Edge Detect Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: RB0IE

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 1 Rising Edge Detect Interrupt Enable Bit\n
BitField.name: RB1IE

BitField.description: DMA Read/Write Data Complete Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: DMAIF

BitField.description: ECC Field Check Error Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nThis bit can check the ECC error on each field (512bytes) of data transfer. Read this bit to check if the error occurred.\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: ECCFLDIF

BitField.description: EDO Mode Entrance Flag (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: EDOF

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 0 Rising Edge Detect Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: RB0IF

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 1 Rising Edge Detect Interrupt Flag (Read Only)\nNote: This bit is read only, but can be cleared by writing '1' to it.
BitField.name: RB1IF

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 0 Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit reflects the Ready/-Busy pin status of NAND Flash.
BitField.name: RB0Status

BitField.description: Ready/-Busy 1 Pin Status (Read Only)\nThis bit reflects the Ready/-Busy pin status of NAND Flash.
BitField.name: RB1Status

BitField.description: NAND Flash Command Port\nWhen CPU writes to this port, NFI will send a command to NAND Flash.
BitField.name: COMMAND

BitField.description: NAND Flash Address Port\nBy writing this port, NAND Flash control will send an address to NAND Flash.
BitField.name: ADDRESS

BitField.description: End of Address\nWrite this bit to indicate if this address is the last one or not. By writing address port with this bit low, the NAND Flash controller will set ALE pin to active (HIGH). After the last address is written (with this bit set high), the NAND Flash controller will set ALE pin to inactive (LOW).\n
BitField.name: EOA

BitField.description: NAND Flash Data Port\nCPU can access NAND's memory array through this data port. When CPU WRITE, the lower 8-bit data from CPU will appear on the data bus of NAND controller. When CPU READ, NAND controller will get 8-bit data from data bus.
BitField.name: DATA

Register.description: NAND Flash Redundant Area Control Register
Register.name: NFI_NANDRACTL

BitField.description:
Redundant Area 128 Byte Enable Bit
These bits indicate NAND Flash extended redundant area. 
Note: The REA128EN must be 4 byte aligned, so bit1 and bit0 can't be filled 1 to it.
The maximum redundant area of the controller is 472 bytes.
BitField.name: RA128EN

BitField.description: Mask ECC During Write Page Data\nThese 16 bits registers indicate NAND controller to write out ECC parity or just 0xFF for each field (every 512 bytes) the real parity data will be write out to NFI_NANDRAx.\n
BitField.name: MECC

BitField.description: NAND Flash Write Protect Control\nSet this bit low (low active) to make NAND_nWP functional pin low to prevent the write to NAND Flash device.\n
BitField.name: WP

Register.description: NAND Flash ECC Error Status 0 Register
Register.name: NFI_NANDECCES0

BitField.description:
Packet Scaling Horizontal Factor M
Specifies the lower 8-bit of denominator part (M) of the horizontal scaling factor.
The lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PKDSHMH) to form a 16-bit denominator (M) of vertical factor.
The output image width will be equal to the image width * N/M.
Note: The value of N must be equal to or less than M.
BitField.name: PKTSHML

BitField.description: Packet Scaling Horizontal Factor n \nSpecify the lower 8-bit of numerator part (N) of the horizontal scaling factor.\nThe lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PKDSHNH) to form a 16-bit numerator of horizontal factor.
BitField.name: PKTSHNL

BitField.description:
Packet Scaling Vertical Factor m 
Specify the lower 8-bit of denominator part (M) of the vertical scaling factor.
The lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PKDSVMH) to form a 16-bit denominator (M) of vertical factor.
The output image width will be equal to the image height * N/M.
Note: The value of N must be equal to or less than M.
BitField.name: PKTSVML

BitField.description: Packet Scaling Vertical Factor n \nSpecify the lower 8-bit of numerator part (N) of the vertical scaling factor. \nThe lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PKDSVNH) to form a 16-bit numerator of vertical factor.
BitField.name: PKTSVNL

BitField.description:
Planar Scaling Horizontal Factor M
Specify the lower 8-bit of denominator part (M) of the horizontal scaling factor.
The lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PNDSHMH) to form a 16-bit denominator (M) of vertical factor.
The output image width will be equal to the image width * N/M.
Note: The value of N must be equal to or less than M.
BitField.name: PLNSHML

BitField.description: Planar Scaling Horizontal Factor n \nSpecify the lower 8-bit of numerator part (N) of the horizontal scaling factor.\nThe lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PNDSHNH) to form a 16-bit numerator of horizontal factor.
BitField.name: PLNSHNL

BitField.description:
Planar Scaling Vertical Factor M
Specify the lower 8-bit of denominator part (M) of the vertical scaling factor.
The lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PNDSVMH) to form a 16-bit denominator (M) of vertical factor.
The output image width will be equal to the image height * N/M.
Note: The value of N must be equal to or less than M.
BitField.name: PLNSVML

BitField.description: Planar Scaling Vertical Factor n \nSpecify the lower 8-bit of numerator part (N) of the vertical scaling factor. \nThe lower 8-bit will be cascaded with higher 8-bit (PNDSVNH) to form a 16-bit numerator of vertical factor.
BitField.name: PLNSVNL

BitField.description:
Scaling Frame Rate Factor M
Specify the denominator part (M) of the frame rate scaling factor.
The output image frame rate will be equal to input image frame rate * (N/M).
Note: The value of N must be equal to or less than M.
BitField.name: FRM

BitField.description: Scaling Frame Rate Factor n\nSpecify the denominator part (N) of the frame rate scaling factor.
BitField.name: FRN

Register.description: Frame Output Pixel Stride Width Register
Register.name: CCAPx_STRIDE

BitField.description: Packet Frame Output Pixel Stride Width\nThe output pixel stride size of the packet pipe.\nIt is a 32-pixel aligned stride width for the Luma-Y-One bit format or a 4-pixel aligned stride with for the Luma-Y-Eight bit format when color or monochrome CMOS sensors used. This means that every new captured line address is word alignment when color or monochrome CMOS sensors used.
BitField.name: PKTSTRIDE

The pre-scale counter is clocked by the divided crystal clock, xCLOCK. 
The divided number is from 1 to 256.

Note:

BitField.description:
Scan Row Delay
Setting delay cycle when row change, for preventing KPI from detecting wrong key.
Note:
scan row delay cycle < debounce sampling cycle.
row scan time > scan row delay cycle + (2 * debounce sampling cycle) + 1 xclock cycle(change row) + 2 xclock cycle(cross clock domain).

E.g. If the crystal clock is 1Mhz then the xCLOCK period is 1us. If the keypad matrix is 3x3. Then,
Note:
When PRESCALE (KPICONF[15:8]) is determined, De-bounce sampling cycle should not exceed the half of (PRESCALE x PrescaleDivider), 
in the above example, and if scan row delay cycle is 4 xclock
The maximum DBCLKSEL(KPICONF[19:16]) should be 1024 x clock, bouncing time is 1 ms.

BitField.description:
EADC Conversion Result
This field contains 12 bits conversion result.
When DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) is set to 0, 12-bit EADC conversion result with unsigned format will be filled in RESULT[11:0] and zero will be filled in RESULT[15:12].
When DMOF (EADC_CTL[9]) set to 1, 12-bit EADC conversion result with 2'complement format will be filled in RESULT[11:0] and signed bits to will be filled in RESULT[15:12].
